Reclassified RattanIndia Power Limited as an associate effective March 25, 2026.

timeline.summary: RattanIndia Enterprises submitted annual auditor compliance certificates for four promoter trusts for FY25-26 pursuant to SEBI takeover regulations.
RattanIndia Enterprises issued a press release on 14 May 2026 saying Revolt riders had covered over 72 crore electric kilometres and saved ₹89.28 Cr in fuel cumulatively.

RattanIndia Enterprises' 29 May 2026 investor presentation reported FY26 total income of ₹7,537 Cr (up 10%), EBITDA of ₹98 Cr excluding a ₹172 Cr mark-to-market loss, Cocoblu revenue of ₹7,351 Cr and NeoSky income up 6x to ₹22.3 Cr.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,696.63 Cr (+12.8% YoY), net loss to shareholders ₹110.28 Cr (against a loss of ₹355.89 Cr a year earlier).
